take_homes: Access is not uptake. Before I tell the board a rollout percentage, count how much of what's available actually gets used.
Make the agent cite its sources and don't trust its own summary. That's the control I can check.
A licence alone is not the point. The company has to write down what it knows and someone has to pick it up.

monday.move: Ask my controller to write down the month-end variance commentary steps, then try an agent on it once and make it cite the source for every number.
monday.stop_condition: The agent cites no source for a number, or it uses data IT hasn't approved.
monday.blocker: IT has not approved the tool for finance data.

misconception.why: The lecture says the model improves for free but what the company knows only improves if someone writes it down and someone else uses it. That makes it more than a licence. I still don't have a monthly cost per person.

one_line: Too much agents-arguing-with-agents and no cost figure anywhere, but the 'count the folders before you promise the board a percentage' point and the 'make them cite' rule were worth the day.
